##Q1: Which counties that have similar diversity populations have different religious faiths at the top? (For example, does a county in Maryland that has a similar diversity percentage as one in another state near Maryland have the same congregations leading?) 
```{r}
q1selectedstates <- state_rel_census |>
  group_by(`State Name`) |>
  summarise(
    count= n()
  ) |>
  
  q1selectedstates |> filter("Maryland")


```

##Q3: What are the top few states that have a majority versus the top few states that have a (somewhat equal) balance of congregations?
```{r}
q3top_staterel <- state_rel_census |>
  select(`State Name`, `Group Name`, Adherents) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Adherents)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Group Name`, values_from = Adherents) %>% 
  
##so this sections off every single state, every congregation name, and how many adherents each state has of every state. now, i want to see which states have a majority (thinking of looking at all 50 but ideally the top ten when i filter it all)
  
state_pop <- get_acs(geography = "state",
              variables = c(population = "B01001_001"),
              year = 2021,
              geometry = TRUE)

state_pop_with_religion <- state_pop |>
  left_join(q3top_staterel, join_by(NAME == `State Name`)) 

q3top_staterel |>
  mutate(rate = `State Name`/`)
  
md_pop_with_religion <- md_county_population |>
  left_join(md_county_religion, join_by(county == `County Name`)) |>
  mutate(rate = Congregations/Adherents*10000) |>
  arrange(desc(rate))
```
